candidates.reason: Paper supports caution about incomplete corrections; existing workflow already requires correction/reference/repair semantics. Native streaming and calibrated gate not established.
candidates.mapping: Optional explanation only; retain reviewer→owner correction and repair/recheck edges, entire event refs and conditions. Pipeline freezes identical inputs/model/tools/budget and independent grading.
candidates.smallest_discriminating_experiment: One matched correction-after-prefix fixture: full delivery versus suppress optional explanation only after complete semantic boundary. Compare correct closure, total generated+gate tokens, actual latency, continuation/repair rounds; counterexample if late correction is lost.
candidates.cost: Low fixture preparation; streaming/gate/model billing unknown; paper rollout branch3, rollout10 and task-specific SFT are not authorized implementation.
